before: always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n_enter) begin
proposal.description: The first stage's clear is synchronous: meta_ff is cleared only if a clk edge samples rst_n_enter low, instead of the instant rst_n_enter falls.
proposal.reason: A reset pulse on rst_n_enter that falls and rises between two clk edges leaves meta_ff at 1, so rst_n_exit (still cleared asynchronously by the second stage) releases on the first clk edge after release instead of the second - the two-clock synchronised release is lost for short pulses.

why: make lint already catches it: make lint: SYNCASYNCNET

before: always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n_enter) begin
proposal.description: The second stage's clear is synchronous: rst_n_exit asserts only on a clk edge, not asynchronously with the fall of rst_n_enter.
proposal.reason: When rst_n_enter falls, rst_n_exit stays high until the next rising clk edge (and never asserts while clk is stopped), instead of falling with zero clock latency; a reset pulse shorter than a clk period shows up at rst_n_exit one edge late, after rst_n_enter is already high again.

why: make lint already catches it: make lint: SYNCASYNCNET
